classification_method: Deterministic symbol-name taxonomy over proven WGSERVER.EXE imports; classification establishes ownership domain only, not implementation semantics.
closed_boundaries: Native message formatting/output calls are owned by WGSERVER host services, not MMUD-local implementations.
DFA record locking/query/update calls are owned by WGSERVER host services.
Clock/calendar and polling entry points are owned by WGSERVER host services.
Random generation entry points _lngrnd and _genrdn are owned by WGSERVER host services.
User/session and input parsing primitives are owned by WGSERVER host services.
limitations: Ownership classification does not recover host algorithms, ordering, seeding, lock durability, or crash recovery.
Indirect calls remain outside the direct-callsite counts inherited from Update0003.
